paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Niddah 45a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.45a.6-8) with a halakhic statement, after which Rav Chisda says: “Come and hear.”[^1]

notes.text: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Ika raises an objection. After the Gemara reformulates the question, Rav Chisda introduces a source with “Come and hear.”
